memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider its ways and be wise!" - Proverbs 6:6

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text: A drunkard from Wales was restored from his addiction through the behavior of his own pet sheep. It is tragic how man, losing his intellect, can sink to a level even lower than that of beasts. Jesus Christ compared the cunning nature of Herod to a fox, and John the Baptist called the Pharisees a brood of vipers. People often lament that man sometimes stings like a scorpion, barks like a dog, kicks like a donkey, and jumps restlessly here and there like a monkey. Just as that addicted man repented upon witnessing the conduct of his pet lamb, when we truly look upon Jesus—the Lamb of God who bore our sins on the cross—we too can completely repent from worldly habits and become like children. The divine grace and redemption that are denied to animals have been freely granted to us. Let us nail our old natures and the bondage of sin to the cross, completely yielding ourselves daily to the guidance of the Holy Spirit. Just as the drunkard's lamb refused to cross the threshold into the tavern, we too must flee far away when sin approaches us. The precious blood of our Savior Jesus Christ, the Lamb of God, will cleanse us, grant us the strength to overcome the deeds of the flesh, and guide us safely at all times.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: ​"Man can sink lower than animals through his pride, but only through divine love can he rise to become a child of God."

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Loving Lord, we bring our weaknesses and bad habits to You. Often, we lack even the basic discernment that an animal possesses. Please help us to look unto Your love as the Lamb of God, to completely put away our old sinful natures, and to live holy in Your presence. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Never be discouraged by your weaknesses. When the grace of the Lamb of God touches your heart, a new transformation and deliverance will surely take place in your life.
